explanation: Almost always 0; it fires only at D2 late in the episode (about trial 88 onward) when the agent chose a1 and reached S1 by a common transition during an unbroken streak of rewarded a1-to-S1 trials, rising from about 6 on the second or third such trial to 8-10 as the streak goes on. A rare transition gives about 2 (0 if the streak was short), and any unrewarded trial, a2 choice or rare transition resets it to 0 for the next few trials, as do all D1 and GO steps and the whole first ~85 trials.
